model: Dexmate Vega 1 U, official wrist-FT + DexGripper S variant
assumptions: Mount, home, PD gains, armature and jaw-pad geometry/material are simulation choices, not manufacturer calibration. Arm effort/velocity limits come from the pinned URDF. Gripper limits are provisional because official URDF effort/velocity fields are zero. Root, stand and head fixed during tabletop work. No mobile-base or torso actuation.
wrist_camera_note: Virtual optics in front of camera housing; preserves left/right wrist streams. Intrinsics/extrinsics are provisional, not measured calibration.
numerics_note: 1 ms implicitfast, unchanged 20 ms controller. Cardboard priority=1 uses its configured contact compliance/friction against table instead of mixing the table defaults. No constraints added to box. No-slip postsolver disabled: comparison detected flat-panel chatter with five no-slip iterations; Coulomb friction/contact solver retained.

jaw_pad_design.type: constant-thickness sloped inner face, parallel at 1.53mm opening and 0.012rad jaw angle
jaw_pad_design.provenance: Custom engineering pad; elastomer density and contact properties provisional. Vendor hand and actuation topology retained.

gripper_control_note: Zero opening uses bounded closing torque plus damping; positive opening uses position PD. Contact force is measured, not equated to nominal torque. Max torque unchanged0.3Nm.
